ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central lobe regions versus 25% low-intensity black pixels localized at the margins and median notch area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields on both lateral lobes. Thick, irregular black perimeter banding along the trailing edges and distal tips. Dark pigmentation mass concentrated at the median notch containing distinct vertical white linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; interior vertex partially obscured by water turbulence; visible edge vectors suggest an angle of approximately 40-45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jagged contour; pixel-amplitude of serrations varies from 5 to 20 pixels along the entire visible trailing edge; higher amplitude peaks noted on the right lobe distal half.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature sweeping toward narrow distal tips; right lobe displays a more pronounced upward sweep relative to the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small white pixel clusters (rosettes) localized at the extreme distal end of the left fluke tip; dark focal spots (mottling) scattered across the high-intensity white field of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 4-5 distinct, parallel vertical white rake marks (linear disruptions) located in the dark pigmentation field immediately right of the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent white parallel rake marks near the notch; irregular jagged 'bite' or notch-like indentation on the distal margin of the right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dense clustering of white micro-speckles at the terminal edge of the left fluke tip against a black background.
